header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2021 and was lastly fixed in the court on 06.10.2021, but thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.

The perusal of prayer clause reflects that this petition was filed against the respondents Nos.1 & 2 to ensure that no false and fake news would be published in the newspaper without verifying and confirming the actual facts, and further for directions to respondent Nos.1 & 2 to take action against the respondents Nos.3, 4, 9 and 10 for publishing the fake news in their newspaper and for commission of violation of the prescribed rules and regulations of PEMRA Act.

In view of above facts, it appears that the petitioner has an alternate remedy to file suit for damages, or if he is aggrieved from the act of said respondents. Even otherwise, this petition is not maintainable as required recording of evidence, and is hereby dismissed. Leaving the petitioner at liberty to approach at proper forum for redressal of his grievance.
